run_multiprocessing_bpe_encode: run the multiprocessing BPE encoder script to encode raw text files using GPT-2 BPE tokenization with multiple worker processes
run_bpe_encode_stdin: run the BPE encoder script piping text from stdin and writing encoded token IDs to stdout
run_bpe_encode_files: run the BPE encoder on input text files and save encoded token output to specified output files
review_MultiprocessingEncoder_class: review the MultiprocessingEncoder class and its encode, decode, encode_lines, and decode_lines methods for BPE tokenization
refactor_MultiprocessingEncoder_workers: refactor the MultiprocessingEncoder to adjust the number of worker processes for parallel BPE encoding
